types.title: Grids Record
types.description: One stable record in a Grids Table.

types.title: Grids Table
types.description: A readable stored or Combined table in a Base.

types.title: Grids View
types.description: A permission-scoped saved GQL data view.

queries.title: Get Grids Base
queries.description: Read one accessible Grids Base by stable ID.

queries.title: List Grids Bases
queries.description: Start here to list accessible Grids Bases and obtain a baseId for schema or GQL calls.

query.description: Optional Base name, description, or short-ID search.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

queries.title: Search Grids Bases
queries.description: Find accessible Grids Bases by name, description, or short ID.

query.description: User-entered search text. Empty text is allowed when a facet narrows the query.

tags.description: Canonical search facets supported by this query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Load Grids GQL context
queries.description: Inspect a Grids Base schema in steps: list Tables, then Fields and paginated select option IDs, or saved Views. Field results include effective write and audit requirements.

baseId.description: Readable Base whose permission-shaped GQL context should be loaded.

kind.description: Catalog section: tables, views, fields, or exact select option IDs.

tableId.description: Readable Table UUID; required for fields and options, optional for views.

fieldId.description: Readable Select Field UUID; required when kind is options.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

queries.title: Execute Grids GQL
queries.description: Run a permission-safe Grids data query after gql.context. Select only needed fields; follow nextCursor for byte-bounded pages up to a 1,000-row logical ceiling.

baseId.description: Readable Base in which the GQL source is resolved.

query.description: Grids Query Language source to execute.

currentTableId.description: Optional readable Table used when the source omits an explicit from clause.

currentSource.description: Optional current Table or View source used when GQL omits from.

kind.description: Select a Table as the current source.
Select a View as the current source.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

pageSize.description: Maximum rows to return on this cursor page.

limit.description: Optional logical result cap across cursor pages.

queries.title: Preview Grids GQL
queries.description: Validate permission-safe GQL before execution and return actionable parser or resolver diagnostics without mutating data.

baseId.description: Readable Base in which the GQL source is resolved.

query.description: Grids Query Language source to execute.

currentTableId.description: Optional readable Table used when the source omits an explicit from clause.

currentSource.description: Optional current Table or View source used when GQL omits from.

kind.description: Select a Table as the current source.
Select a View as the current source.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

queries.title: Execute saved Grids View
queries.description: Run the exact saved Grids data query for a viewId from gql.context kind views; follow nextCursor for byte-bounded pages.

viewId.description: Readable saved View whose exact stored GQL should execute.

pageSize.description: Maximum rows to return on this cursor page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

queries.title: Get Grids Record
queries.description: Read bounded record metadata and its current version for conflict-safe record.update. Use targeted gql.execute selects to read field values.

actions.title: Create Grids Record
actions.description: Call gql.context kind fields first, then create once with values keyed by writable Field UUID. Select values use option IDs. Returns bounded metadata; read values with targeted GQL. This action is not idempotent.

tableId.description: Writable stored Table that should receive the record.

values.description: Field UUIDs mapped to explicitly supplied values.

actions.title: Update Grids Record
actions.description: Load fields for value and audit requirements, then record.get for ifVersion. Only supplied Field UUIDs change; stale versions are rejected. Returns bounded metadata; read values with targeted GQL.

tableId.description: Writable stored Table containing the record.

recordId.description: Stable live record UUID to update.

values.description: Field UUIDs mapped to explicitly supplied replacement values.

ifVersion.description: Record version returned by record.get; stale versions are rejected.

audit.description: Answers required by the Table audit policy, when configured.

answers.description: Audit question UUIDs mapped to their answers.
